def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    one=next((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1)
    two=next((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2)
    r,c=one; R,C=two
    # Diagonal trail toward the marker, ending one row short of its row.
    dr=1 if R>r else -1
    dc=1 if C>c else -1
    steps=min(max(0,abs(R-r)-1), max(0,abs(C-c)-1))
    for k in range(1,steps+1):

        if 0<=rr<len(out) and 0<=cc<len(out[0]): out[rr][cc]=3
    er,ec=r+dr*steps,c+dc*steps
    # At the tip, make a four-cell horizontal bar toward the marker.
    for j in range(4):
        cc=ec+dc*j
        if 0<=er<len(out) and 0<=cc<len(out[0]) and (er,cc)!=two: out[er][cc]=3
    return out

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    r,c=next((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1)
    R,C=next((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2)
    dr=1 if R>r else -1
    dc=1 if C>c else -1
    # Diagonal segment runs until one cell short of the target on the shorter axis.
    n=min(abs(R-r),abs(C-c))-1
    for k in range(1,n+1):
        rr,cc=r+dr*k,c+dc*k
        if 0<=rr<len(out) and 0<=cc<len(out[0]): out[rr][cc]=3
    rr,cc=r+dr*n,c+dc*n
    if abs(R-r)>abs(C-c):
        # remaining vertical tail, at the column one short of the target
        for y in range(rr+dr,R,dr):

    else:
        # remaining horizontal tail, at the row one short of the target
        for x in range(cc+dc,C,dc):
            if 0<=x<len(out[0]): out[rr][x]=3
    return out
